judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the spec and failing acceptance tests, without implementing any of the production code changes in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or adding `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, all the newly added tests will fail immediately (additionally, in `registry.acceptance.test.ts`, the `wrongType` case passes a string `{location: 'person@example.test'}` where `location` is typed as `'string'`, so that test logic is also flawed). The candidate also missed all documentation updates required by the ticket (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) and named the test files `.acceptance.test.ts` instead of using `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as specified.
